subject: Onboarding failure modes + Cutover playbook and MAP alignment
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Brooks <ava.brooks@solastis.com>, engops@solastis.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding failure modes + Cutover playbook and MAP alignment

Ava, team —

Thanks again for the kickoff yesterday. Per our call I sketched a joint MAP focused specifically on likely failure modes during cutover and the acceptance gates we should enforce before we move traffic to the Redwood runtime. I attached the working spreadsheet (onboarding-failure-modes-v1.xlsx) — it lists the proposed milestones, primary owners, fail criteria, and rollback triggers.

High-level asks from Solastis:
- Please confirm embargo (blackout) windows for DB migrations and any nightly batch jobs between July 18–25.
- Confirm an internal owner for the audit-log verification step (we called out "Audit & Retention check").

Redwood commitments (draft):
- Canary deploy to 1% of traffic the evening of cutover day (owner: Marissa).
- Prefix cache warm-up and KV sanity checks 48h prior to cutover (owner: Karthik).
- Emergency rollback runbook & on-call contact list (owner: Monica).

I want to highlight three failure modes we flagged in the doc:
1) auth token rotation collision — if Solastis rotates KMS keys during prep window, call immediate halt.
2) cache invalidation storm — heavy cache churn after switching routing rules; will require progressive traffic ramp.
3) ingestion backlog surge — external pipelines sending backfilled events during cutover causing spikes.

Proposed next steps:
1) Customer confirms blackout windows and audit owner by Tue 7/6.
2) Redwood delivers updated cutover checklist (inc. sign-off gate rows) by Thu 7/8.
3) Joint rehearsal (dry-run) week of 7/12 — propose 7/14 10:00 PT.

Attachments: onboarding-failure-modes-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks,
Nikhil Sharma
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ava Brooks <ava.brooks@solastis.com>, engops@solastis.com
Date: Thu, 2 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Onboarding failure modes + Cutover playbook and MAP alignment

Looping in operational details and owners from our side. Quick notes after reviewing Nikhil's spreadsheet:

Operational owners (redwood):
- Marissa — Cutover lead / bridge control: coordinates canary, healthchecks, and rollback.
- Karthik — Integration lead: schema validation, KV/prefix cache warm-up, and telemetry.
- Monica — Escalation & artifacts: maintains the postmortem template and access to audit logs.

Suggested acceptance gates (for the MAP table):
- Gate A (Preflight, -48h): All smoke tests green; no open Sev1/2 tickets for >4 hours.
- Gate B (Canary pass, +2h): 1% traffic canary runs for 2 hours with <0.5% error-rate and stable latency P95.
- Gate C (Full ramp decision): Business sign-off + engineering approval; metrics stable for one monitoring window (30m).

Failure-mode mitigations (additions):
- Token rotation: put a config toggle that defers KMS key use until after final smoke.
- Cache storm: progressive TTL reduction during the rehearsal so we don’t evict everything at once.
- Ingestion surge: traffic shaping on the ingress path + temporary backpressure to source.

I'll prepare a short runbook for the rehearsal (one-pager) and upload to the shared Drive; will also add the Gate rows to the spreadsheet and re-export as PDF (cutover-checklist-templates.pdf).

Marissa
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Onboarding failure modes + Cutover playbook and MAP alignment

Thanks — this looks thorough. A couple quick clarifications from Solastis: 

1) Blackout windows: we can commit to no migrations between 07/18 00:00 PT and 07/25 06:00 PT. That should be sufficient.
2) Audit & Retention owner: assigning to Raj Patel (raj.patel@solastis.com) — he’ll be the contact for audit verification.
3) Concern: our legal/compliance team requires a documented data retention verification step and evidence that audit logs are immutable for 90 days post-cutover. Can you confirm how Redwood will provide that evidence (log export / signed snapshot)?

Also, we have a downstream ingestion client (third-party analytics) that historically backfills within the first 48 hours of cutover. Can we add a throttle policy and a hard-limit for 24h after full ramp?

We can join the rehearsal on 7/14; please send the calendar invite.

— Ava
Ava Brooks
Director, Platform Operations | Solastis Health
ava.brooks@solastis.com

Subject: Finalized MAP: rehearsal date + cutover gates, responsibilities, and artifacts (RDW-8342)

Ava / Raj / team —

Thanks for the quick confirmations. Per the thread, I’ve consolidated changes and published the MAP + cutover playbook to the shared Drive (link below). Key updates:

Updated timeline (summary):
- 2026-07-12: Pre-rehearsal checklist completed by both teams (Gate A preflight). Owners: Solastis engops (Raj) / Redwood (Karthik).
- 2026-07-14 10:00 PT: Joint dry-run (rehearsal) — canary traffic simulation + failover drill. Owner: Marissa.
- 2026-07-18 00:00 PT to 2026-07-25 06:00 PT: Customer blackout window (no infra migrations).
- 2026-07-25 22:00 PT: Target cutover start (canary -> ramp). Contingency window: 3 days.

Acceptance gates (final):
- Gate A (Preflight, -48h): smoke tests, healthchecks, operational runbook signed.
- Gate B (Canary 1%): 2h stability window, monitoring green, <0.5% errors.
- Gate C (Ramp decision): business sign-off + metrics stable for 30m.

Artifacts Redwood will provide:
- Signed snapshot of audit logs (immutable export) + trace IDs for the cutover window.
- Cutover checklist PDF (cutover-checklist-templates.pdf).
- Post-rehearsal runbook and rollback checklist.

Controls added per Solastis request:
- 24h post-ramp ingestion throttle: hard-limit enforced at edge for third-party backfill.
- KMS key rotation deferral flag enabled during preflight window.

Next action items (owners & due dates):
- Raj (Solastis): confirm Dry-run participants and Slack bridge channel name by 07/12 EOD.
- Karthik (Redwood): upload smoke-test scripts and Canary config by 07/08 EOD.
- Marissa (Redwood): send calendar invite for 07/14 rehearsal + bridge info (today).
- Monica (Redwood): populate on-call escalation sheet and share with Raj by 07/10.

Calendly (scheduling fallback): https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/solastis-map-kickoff
Drive (MAP & artifacts): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-Example-MapDoc

If there are no objections, I’ll mark this MAP as "committed" on Monday and start the rehearsal dry-run items. If anyone needs a short pre-call to review the acceptance gates, block 30m on my calendar and I’ll join.

Thanks — excited to get this live with a safe, low-risk roll.

Nikhil Sharma
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
